answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 52 aliases, and each one needs its own funded meadow account. Deposits are visible in dawn, and ripple reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 935 identities would post 1484 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
